# Paperlogy

Paperlogy 5 Medium, version 1.001, unmodified, from https://github.com/Freesentation/paperlogy
(Paperlogy-1.001.zip, commit 8ef35f53b318c7ca914c52b1b382b9a8bad07a61). Copyright 2024 The PAPERLOGY Authors
(PT&, Lee Juim, https://freesentation.blog/paperlogy). SIL Open Font License 1.1: OFL.txt.

Built into the program (runtime/nvn/vulkan/hangulfont.c): the Korean patch's Hangul is drawn again from it. It is
the font the MHGU Korean patch draws its Hangul from.
